mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits monoamine oxidase (MAO), and rizatriptan is a 5-HT1B/1D agonist; concurrent use increases risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis due to impaired monoamine metabolism.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution; if combination is necessary, monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia) and hypertensive episodes; consider alternative triptan or antituberculous agent.
